module20.title: Final Capstone: Design and Certification Strategy for Two Sauna Heaters
module20.objective: Apply the curriculum to the two actual products you intend to develop.

topics.title: Product A requirements and architecture
topics.why: Product A needs a coherent requirements and certification package for review by engineers and laboratories.
questions: Which wattage variants are feasible on standard residential circuits?
What plug and receptacle configurations may be appropriate?
Can multiple wattage variants be included in one certification family?
Should the heater or complete cabin be certified?
What information must be obtained from an NRTL?
